name: Build Linux no-container

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      platform:
        description: 'Target platform (e.g., linux-arm64)'
        required: true
        type: string
      python-version:
        description: 'Python version to use'
        required: true
        type: string
      cuda-version:
        description: 'CUDA version to install'
        required: true
        type: string
      compiler:
        description: 'C/C++ compiler to use'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: gcc
      submodules:
        description: 'Whether to checkout submodules'
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: true
      checkout-mode:
        description: 'Checkout mode for actions/checkout'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: fetch
      github-token:
        description: 'GitHub token for API access'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
    outputs:
      wheel-path:
        description: 'Path to the built wheel'
        value: ${{ steps.get_wheel.outputs.wheel_path }}

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build Flash Attention
    runs-on: [self-hosted, Linux]
    steps:
      - name: Harden runner
        uses: step-security/harden-runner@20cf305ff2072d973412fa9b1e3a4f227bda3c76
        with:
          allowed-endpoints: |
            github.com
            api.github.com
            objects.githubusercontent.com
            registry-1.docker.io
            auth.docker.io
            auth.docker.io
          egress-policy: block
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          disable-telemetry: true
          disable-sudo: true
          disable-sudo-and-containers: true
          disable-file-monitoring: true
          policy: default

      - name: Setup Linux environment
        uses: pytorch/pytorch/.github/actions/setup-linux@main
        with:
          use-arc: false
          python-version: ${{ inputs.python-version }}
          compiler: ${{ inputs.compiler }}
          cuda-version: ${{ inputs.cuda-version }}
          submodules: ${{ inputs.submodules }}
          checkout-mode: ${{ inputs.checkout-mode }}
          github-token: ${{ inputs.github-token }}
        id: setup

      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: ${{ inputs.submodules }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          ref: ${{ github.ref }}

      - name: Build and upload wheel
        uses: ./.github/actions/build-and-upload
        with:
          python-version: ${{ inputs.python-version }}
          cuda-version: ${{ inputs.cuda-version }}
          compiler: ${{ inputs.compiler }}
          setup-cuda-version: v1.3.0
          python-preference: only-managed
          artifact-name: flash-attention-${{ inputs.platform }}-wheel
        id: build

      - name: Locate built wheel
        id: get_wheel
        run: |
          WHEEL=$(find dist -name "*.whl" | head -n 1)
          echo "wheel_path=$WHEEL" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
        shell: bash

      - name: Post-build cleanup (self-hosted)
        if: runner.self-hosted
        run: |
          echo "Cleaning up build artifacts..."
          rm -rf flash-attention
          rm -rf venv
          rm -rf ~/.cache/pip
          rm -rf ~/.cache/uv
          rm -rf /usr/local/cuda
        shell: bash
